fusions.name: Silk Dart
fusions.desc: Flicks a strand that deals 4 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 35% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 4 seconds. You heal for 12% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Wrapped and Drained
fusions.desc: Binds the target in silk, dealing 14 poison damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, using up every affliction you have on it and dealing 60% more damage for each one. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Webbed Larder
fusions.desc: Spins a trap onto the nearest enemy that waits 1 minute; the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 20 damage in a blast around it. You restore 10 health when you cast it.

fusions.name: Spiderling Pantry
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar of poison that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage. It also applies poison, dealing 2 damage per tick for 4 ticks.
